title: Thea B NDE
content:
My experience may not seem to be the proudest to some. But, I have a feeling that a particular part of this is needed by someone, so I feel inspired to write it.

In April 2020, my mother passed unexpectedly. I was her emergency number, so I was contacted. She hit her head and passed away that night. I was coming in another state. When I got to her home, I saw the blood where she had fallen down. Fast forward 1-1/2 years later. I still mourned her especially because she was alone. I felt like she was scared and hurting although she went to sleep and passed over.

In July 2021 my father was diagnosed with stage 4 cancer. On the same day, at 4:30 am I passed out and was life-flighted to the hospital. Unbeknownst to me, I had a bleeding ulcer. I went through all of the bodily stages of dying except my heartbeat didn't flatline. I didn’t die, but basically had no bodily senses except at some points I did have hearing. At one point, I had this wave of all earthly stresses wash away. Then I had the most overwhelming feeling of love that I have ever felt. Words cannot express this. When I came back to consciousness the next day, I somehow knew that the reason for my experience was to let me know that my mom didn’t suffer; that she was at peace and my father would also be at peace when it was his time.

After he passed, I struggled and wanted to die. I couldn’t shake the pain. One night, I cried until I had nothing left. Then I had two thoughts come to my mind; one was to listen and the other was don’t question. I closed my eyes, still crying but tossing and turning for about another 1/2 hour. Then there was a bright light in the room, so I opened my eyes. It was piercing through the window and it looked like a pinhole where it originated and opened up to me. The light was extremely bright but didn’t hurt my eyes. It was comforting. I reached towards it and my hand sort of melted into it. What I mean is that it went around my hand; not like the sun where your hand blocks the light. Instantly, I knew I was loved and would be ok. The light grew bigger and I knew I had to turn away because it wasn’t my time to go. I knew that if I kept looking at the light, my desire of leaving this world would be granted. After that, I have only cried once for my parents but it wasn’t the same. That night, my pain was healed.

After that I remembered an experience, which I truly believe was an OBE, when I was about a year old. I always remembered the experience like it was yesterday but it never occurred to me that my viewpoint wasn’t from my body.

One night, I was in the backseat of the car with my sister. My parents were in the front seat. This incident happened before seatbelts and car seats were installed in cars. I opened the back door and flew out into a ditch. For anyone not familiar with the ditches in the southern USA they are huge and really deep. From this moment, I was looking at the whole scene from above. I saw my mom turn and look in the backseat and she let my dad know in a panic that I had fallen out. I saw them stopping and jumping out of the car to look for me. I still remember thinking how pretty my mom’s hair was and what they were wearing. Then my father yelled frantically 'Thea where are you!' In a second I was back in the ditch and a huge cockroach was crawling to my face, so I started screaming and crying. This is what alerted them to where I was at.

If I had to say anything about my experiences, remember that the other side is real. We do exist outside of this life. Believe. Do good. Open your heart to others. I know I have been healed and shown what is meant of me in this life because of these experiences. If this helped you then it was also a reason for what happened to me. Love you all.

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: She interpreted the experience as meant to reassure her that her mother did not suffer and would be at peace, and advised others: "Believe. Do good. Open your heart to others."

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Bleeding ulcer; passed out at 4:30 am and was life-flighted to the hospital.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: She also described a prior NDE-like medical crisis (bleeding ulcer) with "wave of all earthly stresses wash away" and "overwhelming feeling of love" without explicit OBE/tunnel/environment details.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Two episodes: (1) medical crisis with loss of bodily senses and overwhelming love; (2) later bedside bright-light encounter with an implied 'not my time' boundary and turning away.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: A later non-near-death bright-light encounter in her room that she believed could have granted her wish to die if she kept looking; she also recalled an OBE-like childhood accident (fell from a car) viewing the scene from above and then suddenly returning to the ditch.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “At one point, I had this wave of all earthly stresses wash away. Then I had the most overwhelming feeling of love that I have ever felt. Words cannot express this.” / “The light was extremely bright but didn’t hurt my eyes. It was comforting.” / “I knew I had to turn away because it wasn’t my time to go.” / “remember that the other side is real. We do exist outside of this life.”
